title: 8-cell MACRO headline recomputed with an UNCONTAMINATED (disjoint-trained) open-text verifier -- accuracy AND cost, with the sample-weighted column kept for contrast.
headline_level: clean_L1 (no eval image, no eval item)
l2_status: LOWER BOUND ONLY -- L2 additionally strips every training item sharing an eval question text, which on these templated sets removes legitimate in-distribution coverage and conflates de-contamination with distribution shift.

contaminated.description: deployed verifier -- trained on 67-73% of the very items it scores

clean_L1.description: HEADLINE: no eval image, no eval item; question templates may recur

clean_L2.description: LOWER BOUND ONLY: L1 + no eval question text (starves the in-domain pools)

what_was_swapped.only: the verifier P(correct) scores on the three open-text cells
identical_across_arms: every multiple-choice cell (never touches the verifier)
what_was_swapped.mechanism: exact-path redirect of transfer_dump_{ds}_lingshu7b.json at builtins.open; no pipeline code is duplicated or re-implemented

validation.note: Every accuracy level, every delta point estimate AND both CI bounds, every per-cell escalation rate and every cost ratio in the contaminated column matched the published artifact EXACTLY (same RNG stream replayed), so the clean column differs only because the verifier differs.

cost_provenance.source: honest_recosting.py M1_primary (measured decode rate + 665 ms/126.9 J direct anchor)

open_arm_bo8_parity.what: the FIXED best-of-8 + verifier-confidence-gate open arm -- the arm the published '3.97% escalation / 548.3 ms / -94.8% latency' claim describes (METHOD_FINAL_2026-07.md 5.x). tau is cross-fit to reach 32B-no-think parity at minimum escalation, so a weaker verifier buys parity by escalating more.
open_arm_bo8_parity.cost_model: lat = BO8 522.0 ms + esc x 665.0 ms; FLOP-eq = 16.0 + esc x 4.57; energy = 568.8 J + esc x 127.0 J (all measured batch-1 constants)

open_arm_pandora_pipeline.what: the arm the macro headline actually costs: Pandora adaptive-N (draw-and-stop) + gate. This is what cost.open_only reports.

joint_claim.basis: accuracy verdict from the macro 8-cell paired bootstrap; cost from the honestly re-costed FLOP-eq / batch-1 latency / energy, macro-averaged over the same 8 cells.

honest_headline.primary_granularity: 8 reporting cells, 1/8 each; open-text verifier trained on strictly disjoint data (L1: no eval image, no eval item)
honest_headline.corrected_joint_claim_sentence: Macro-averaged over the 8 benchmark cells and with an uncontaminated open-text verifier, the method NO LONGER beats a single 32B forward pass: accuracy-max is +0.0008 [-0.0022, +0.0037] vs always-32B-direct (a statistical TIE, down from the published +0.0107 [+0.0086, +0.0127]) while costing 1.74x its FLOP-eq, +16.7% batch-1 latency and +101.0% energy; compute-lean is now a SIGNIFICANT LOSS at -0.0124 [-0.0188, -0.0060] and 1.46x the compute. What survives is the comparison against a 32B actually made to reason: +0.0601 [+0.0498, +0.0703] accuracy at -87.7% latency and -84.3% energy (though 1.74x as-charged / 1.40x honestly re-costed FLOP-eq, i.e. not fewer FLOPs), plus the standalone finding that reasoning mode is actively harmful on free-text medical VQA.
honest_headline.one_line_if_only_one_number_is_allowed: 8-cell macro, clean verifier: accuracy-max +0.0008 [-0.0022, +0.0037] vs always-32B-direct at 1.74x its compute -- a tie bought with more compute, not a win.

what_each_correction_costs.note: on the headline comparison (accuracy-max vs always-32B-direct, all 8 cells). Macro re-weighting alone slightly HELPED this comparison (+0.0021); the clean verifier is what removed it (-0.0120). The two corrections are separable and the table in side_by_side_claims separates them for every claim.

open_arm_honest_latency.claim_audited: open arm: 3.97% escalation, 548.3 ms batch-1, -94.8% vs always-32B-reasoning
open_arm_honest_latency.sentence: The open arm's published '-94.8% batch-1 latency' becomes -93.3% sample-weighted / -92.0% macro against always-32B-with-reasoning -- the headline percentage barely moves because the reasoning baseline is 10.5 s. The figure that actually breaks is the one against a single 32B forward: at 3.97% escalation the arm was 17.5% faster than always-32B-direct (548.4 ms vs 665 ms); a clean verifier needs 26.9% escalation (48.7% macro) to hold the same parity target, so the arm becomes +5.4% sample-weighted / +27.2% macro -- i.e. SLOWER than just running the 32B once, at 3.77x its FLOP-eq.

what_survives: vs always-32B-WITH-REASONING the accuracy margin still GROWS under macro even after de-contamination (accuracy-max +0.0601 [+0.0498, +0.0703] macro+clean vs +0.0245 sample-weighted contaminated) and the latency/energy advantage stays large (-87.7% / -84.3%).

The 'reasoning mode is actively harmful on free-text medical VQA' result is untouched by the verifier and by the weighting: PathVQA-open 0.1087 reasoning vs 0.3760 direct, SLAKE-open 0.6791 vs 0.8186, VQA-RAD-open 0.5450 vs 0.6000.
On the 5 multiple-choice cells accuracy-max still beats always-32B-direct (+0.0019 [+0.0014, +0.0024]); that half never used the verifier.

The verifier is still a real ranker after de-contamination (candidate AUROC 0.943 -> 0.886 at L1, per verifier_disjoint_retrain_2026-07-30.json); what collapsed is oracle CONVERSION, and with it the arm's ability to hold parity at low escalation.
what_does_not_survive: 'The method beats a single 32B forward pass.' Under macro + clean L1 accuracy-max is +0.0008 [-0.0022, +0.0037] vs always-32B-direct -- a TIE -- and accuracy-max-fusion is a significant LOSS (-0.0063 [-0.0118, -0.0011]).
'Compute-lean matches the strong model at half the compute.' Under macro + clean L1 it is -0.0124 [-0.0188, -0.0060] (a significant LOSS) at 1.46x the compute of always-32B-direct.
'The open-text arm beats always-32B-direct.' Macro + clean L1: accuracy-max -0.0010 [-0.0090, +0.0067] (TIE), compute-lean -0.0214 [-0.0360, -0.0074] (LOSS).

'The method Pareto-dominates the 32B baselines.' Under macro + clean L1 (honestly re-costed) compute-lean and accuracy-max-fusion are both strictly DOMINATED by always-32B-direct; only accuracy-max-veto stays on the frontier, and only by a +0.0008 accuracy edge that is not statistically distinguishable from zero.

does_accuracy_max_still_beat_32b_direct_.answer: NO -- it no longer beats it

compute_lean_multiple_choice_loss.note: unchanged by the verifier -- the MCQ cells never touch it; listed so the reader sees the macro-only correction is what created this loss, not the de-contamination.

statistics_note: Items are bootstrapped WITHIN each cell (paired across systems, exact pattern-multinomial draw) and the macro average is recomputed per replicate. The CIs therefore capture WITHIN-dataset sampling noise ONLY -- they do NOT capture dataset-selection noise. With 5-8 datasets, resampling datasets is hopelessly unstable, so a leave-one-cell-out point range is given instead.
caveats: The de-contamination changes ONLY the three open-text cells. Every multiple-choice result in this file is identical across arms by construction; where a multiple-choice claim moves, the macro re-weighting caused it, not the verifier.

L1 keeps question TEMPLATES that recur with different images. That is ordinary generalization on templated medical VQA, not leakage; L2 removes them and is reported as a conservative lower bound only.
The Pandora open arm's iso-accuracy target a_fix is itself derived from the bo8+verifier arm, so a weaker verifier lowers the target as well as the delivered accuracy.
32B-with-reasoning on the open cells is a MEASURED judged per-sample vector (opentext_32b_think_full); on PATH_VQA_closed there is no reasoning dump, so reasoning = direct there.
FLOP-eq counts every 7B forward in full; batch-1 latency does not, because the best-of-N draws are issued in parallel. The two axes disagree for the open arm and both are given.
